elements.name: night bus station yard in Addis Ababa
shorter young man with backpack seen from behind in centre
second young man in blue denim jacket with nothing on his back
five men in half circle gesturing with open hands
men painted as faceless dark silhouettes against bright lamps

wrong_setting: The scene reads as a hazy daytime rather than night, despite the lit lamps.
notes: Repaint with both young men side by side: the backpack wearer in a charcoal jacket, white shirt, rolled olive trousers and blue closed-toe sandals, plus the taller one in a denim jacket with nothing on his back; there are only four silhouettes, so add a fifth, and make it clearly night.
